ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)

   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants ENVIRONMENT.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)

   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

15. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

16. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.

18. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
